jobs.description:
The opportunity
As a Real Estate Facility Manager with us, you are responsible for managing both leased and owned premises and maintain daily contact with the operations that take place in these facilities. You have budget responsibility and ensure that maintenance plans are developed and implemented. You act as a requirements setter in construction projects and coordinate property-related matters. You collaborate with business units and support functions, taking overall responsibility for understanding current and future needs.
How you’ll make an impact
Budget responsibility and follow-up for the different sites
Act as the primary contact between Hitachi and property owners as well as their subcontractors
Place orders for assignments in collaboration with both internal and external colleagues
Plan and monitor both preventive and corrective maintenance as well as various construction projects
Ensure compliance with applicable directives, regulatory requirements, and laws
Financial follow-up and evaluation of signed agreements
Operational and personnel responsibility for the daily activities within the property management unit

Your background
Relevant education and extensive experience in property management for commercial and industrial facilities
Minimum 10 years in similar roles, including personnel responsibility
Strong negotiation, communication, and leadership skills; proven ability to manage projects and maintenance budgets
Expertise in project management, reporting, and developing maintenance plans
Solid knowledge of tenancy and contract law, as well as regulatory compliance
Structured and detail-oriented approach with excellent documentation skills
Proficiency in Swedish and English, both spoken and written; driver’s license required

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. jobs.occupation: Advance Your Career as a Consultant Pathologist in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a specialist in pathology looking for a role where you can combine advanced diagnostics with a balanced lifestyle?
We are currently seeking specialist surgical pathologists to join a modern and accredited department in central Sweden, located in a region known for its coastal setting, rich history, and strong connection to nature.
About the Department
The surgical pathology and cytology unit plays a central role in diagnostics by analyzing tissue and cell samples using both microscopy and advanced digital systems. The goal is to provide accurate and timely diagnostic support to clinicians, improving patient outcomes and safety.
The department is part of a larger organization within laboratory medicine and is at the forefront of digital pathology, with ongoing development in automation, robotics, and AI-driven diagnostics.
In addition to histopathology and cytology, the unit is also responsible for:
Gynecological screening programs
Autopsy services and morgue operations
Multidisciplinary clinical conferences
You will work in a collaborative and well-structured environment with experienced colleagues across multiple disciplines.
Your role
As a specialist surgical pathologist, your work will include:
Diagnostic work in histopathology and cytology
Gross examination and specimen handling
Participation in clinical conferences and interdisciplinary discussions
Autopsy
Supervising and mentoring residents

Daytime on-call service for urgent diagnostic cases is shared within the team.
Qualifications
EU-recognized specialist certification in pathology
Experience in surgical pathology
Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-based environment
A structured, collaborative, and flexible approach

Why work here?
This opportunity is located in a coastal region of central Sweden, offering a unique mix of professional development and quality of life. The area is known for:
Easy access to the sea, forests, and outdoor activities year-round
A rich industrial and cultural heritage
A safe and family-friendly environment
Good infrastructure with connections to larger cities
The working environment is modern, forward-thinking, and continuously evolving, providing excellent conditions for both professional growth and long-term career development.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype
Take the next step in your career
This is an excellent opportunity for surgical pathologists who want to work in a progressive environment while enjoying a high quality of life.
Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?
Don’t hesitate to contact me. I look forward to hearing from you and helping you find the perfect job that matches your experience and ambitions.
Apply now!

jobs.occupation: Exciting Radiologist Position in the Heart of Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a board-certified radiologist looking for a new challenge in a beautiful part of Sweden?
This position combines professional development with a high quality of life in a scenic region known for its lakes, forests and outdoor lifestyle.
About the hospital and department
The radiology department is part of the Diagnostic Imaging and Functional Medicine division and performs around 24,000 examinations annually. The unit is equipped with two ultrasound machines, one MRI, one CT scanner and two conventional X-ray systems (one with fluoroscopy). Both acute and planned diagnostic services are provided in modern facilities with continuously updated technology.
You will join a skilled and stable team of radiologists, radiographers, nurses and administrative staff. Staff turnover among doctors has been close to zero in recent years. The department is also preparing for a major upgrade of both premises and equipment in the near future.
Tasks and responsibilities
Broad diagnostic radiology including conventional X-ray, ultrasound and CT.
Participation in both acute and planned care.
Collaboration with other clinical specialties.
On-call duties are possible but not mandatory (primarily organised from a nearby hospital).

Requirements
Specialist certification in radiology from an EU/EEA country, recognised by EU directive 2005/36/EC.
Several years of clinical experience preferred, but not mandatory.
Skills in ultrasound and CT required; fluoroscopy and interventional procedures are a plus.
Good command of English. Willingness to learn Swedish to minimum B2/C1 level (language training provided).

Personal profile
Cooperative and a team player, while able to work independently.
Flexible and adaptable in a changing clinical environment.
Service-minded and attentive in patient interaction.
Proactive and quality-focused.

Terms and conditions
Full-time, Monday–Friday, daytime hours.
Competitive salary
Permanent employment in the Swedish public healthcare system.
Relocation package and intensive Swedish language training included.

Why this location?
The hospital is located in the heart of Hälsingland, a region offering a unique combination of professional challenges and an exceptional quality of life. Here you will find affordable housing, short commutes, and endless opportunities for outdoor activities such as hiking, skiing, and fishing – all within reach of a modern healthcare environment.
Application process
Please send a complete application including:
CV and cover letter
Diplomas and specialist certificate
Employment references
Information on your availability to start language training and relocation

EU/EEA candidates only. Swedish medical license and specialist recognition from the National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen) are required before independent practice. Support will be provided throughout this process.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Swedish Speaking Online Content Moderator/Customer Support Agent
jobs.description:
Besedo is a Swedish company with offices in five locations around the world, providing content 
moderation solutions to leading online marketplaces, dating sites, and sharing economy services. 
Our automation tool, Implio, facilitates fast and easy moderation, often in combination with our 
manual services.  Besedo is a very multicultural company, and it shows through our employees, 
who between them, boast a range of 17 different languages. Besedo is a fast-growing tech
company providing tools and services to online marketplaces around the world. 
At Besedo, our moderation teams are at the core of our business and essential to our success. 
We invest in our co-workers and love to see you grow with the company. In fact, 50% of our 
managers and experts started as content moderators. 
Join a vibrant, international team in Malta, dedicated to making the internet a safer place for all! 

Job description:  
Your Role and Responsibilities:  
-Supporting users and answer their questions via email 
-Reviewing and moderating ads and user-profiles, with high accuracy at a fast pace 
-Participating in regular training sessions to learn and maintain expert knowledge of 
publication rules, market trends and moderation best practices 
-Collaborating with your team members 
-Providing feedback to managers on trends, common end-user mistakes and questions. 
You are our eyes and ears and you know the users the best! 
-Giving input on improvements of publication rules to improve user experiences 

Requirements 
-Fluent in Swedish and have good knowledge of English 
-Flexible and able to make quick decisions in a dynamic environment 
-Conscientious and reliable - commitment is one of our core values! 
-Eagle-eyed with great attention to details 
-Caring about people - you will be working with securing the online safety our customers 
and their users 
-Ideally interested in marketplaces, shared economy and new technology 
-Previous experience in content moderation, customer care and/or online business is a 
plus 

Vacancy additional information 
Any other benefits 
-An opportunity to make a positive impact on the digital world, by making the internet 
a safer place. 
-A stimulating and rewarding job in a fast-moving, innovative and international tech
company. 
-Career opportunities within a management or expert field. 
-Additional vacation days. 
-Free fruit, tea and coffee if you prefer working in the office. 
-Ability to work from home when working late shifts and weekends.  Night Shifts are until 
Midnight! 
-Free day transport to the office from certain areas within Malta. 
-Team performance bonus and working from home allowance,  
-Corporate discounts for gym memberships, shops and taxi's. 
-Private Health Insurance, eye care tests, health and well-being professional support. 
-Refer a friend bonus scheme.  
-Comprehensive training and constant feedback. 
-Fun events, great colleagues and a fresh, playful workplace with a variety of cultures. 
-Relocation packages for international applicants. 

The enduring goal of Besedo in Malta is that the composition of our workforce should reflect

Klättermusen is looking for an Accounting Manager
Since 1975 Klättermusen has been a pioneer in making refined Scandinavian Mountaineering Equipment. The designs combine utility and extreme durability, always with consideration of the environment in mind. Klättermusen supports and inspire outdoor enthusiasts through unforgiving weather conditions and unpredictable terrains. Rigorously tested in real-world conditions, the equipment embodies Klättermusen’s commitment to creating the best and most sustainable equipment available.
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Accounting Manager to lead Klättermusen’s accounting operations and further develop the financial processes supporting our international business.

The role has overall responsibility for accurate, timely and compliant accounting across the Group’s legal entities and combines operational accounting expertise with team leadership and process ownership. The Accounting Manager works closely with our CFO, Financial Controller and accounting team members. The position is based at our headquarters in Åre and reports to the CFO.

Responsibilities

Lead and coordinate day-to-day accounting across Klättermusen’s legal entities.

Lead, support and develop the accounting team and allocate daily priorities and responsibilities.

Own the monthly and annual accounting reconciliation and consolidation closing process.

Coordinate inter company accounting, reconciliations, settlements as well as TP adjustments based on policy in place.

Coordinate VAT, employer, tax and other statutory financial reporting in relevant jurisdictions.

Coordinate preparation of statutory annual accounts and supporting documentation.

Act as a key finance contact for auditors and external accounting, tax and payroll partners.

Own and secure our internal controls, approval processes and accounting documentation.

Drive standardisation, automation and continuous improvement of accounting processes.

Support effective use and development of Business Central and related finance systems.

Support implementation of accounting structures for new legal entities, channels and markets.

Work closely with the Financial Controller to provide high-quality input to Group reporting.

Support the CFO with accounting matters, financial controls and finance projects

Qualifications

Relevant degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or equivalent professional experience.

At least five years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in an international or multi-entity environment.

Strong knowledge of financial accounting, reconciliations, closing processes and statutory reporting.

Experience coordinating VAT, tax and other regulatory financial reporting.

Strong ERP and Excel skills; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is advantageous.

Professional working proficiency in English and Swedish.

Structured, hands-on and comfortable managing several entities and deadlines simultaneously.

High level of integrity, accuracy, ownership and professional judgement.

Collaborative and able to work across countries, functions and organisational levels

What Klättermusen offers

A forward-thinking design environment in a global outdoor brand

Close collaboration with international production, sourcing teams, and testing environments

Opportunities for creative impact and professional growth

A workplace immersed in the outdoors — Åre is both our home and our testing ground.

The position is full time position based in Åre. Welcome to apply by January 13th, 2026.

We only accept applications through this channel. Your application will be stored in our database, and we will contact you if a suitable position becomes available. Applications will be handled on an ongoing basis.

At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a Customer Operations & Loan Specialist (DACH Region) for the next phase of growth.
About the Role
You will directly impact small business growth by evaluating credit applications and guiding German-speaking entrepreneurs through tailored financing solutions. This role bridges direct customer engagement with financial assessment, giving you end-to-end ownership of customer onboarding and credit execution in a rapidly scaling market.
Key responsibilities
Evaluate business loan applications by analyzing operational performance and credit risk in partnership with underwriting.

Manage high-volume customer inquiries across phone, chat, and email to ensure fast and transparent loan processing.

Structure customized financing proposals that align with applicant business models and cash flow requirements.

Develop long-term customer relationships through proactive account management and product portfolio adoption.

Transition into full credit underwriting authority to independently approve and manage small business loans over time.

What we’re looking for
You bring a structured, analytical approach to problem-solving and excel at building trust with business owners. You are motivated by operational ownership, adapt quickly to changing priorities, and want to contribute to building robust customer operations frameworks.
Qualifications
Native-level or fluent professional proficiency in German, alongside strong working proficiency in English.

Practical background in customer operations, client management, or sales within financial services or fintech.

Foundational experience analyzing financial statements, credit data, or business metrics.

Educational background in business, economics, finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Why Qred?
This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!
One Last Thing
This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.

jobs.occupation: We are looking for a C#.NET developer!
jobs.description:
Join a high-performance engineering environment where you will tackle complex logic and massive datasets. Our client leverages custom database structures and heavy algorithms to drive innovation in scalable backend architecture. Apply today as we use ongoing selection.
About the role
Our client is a well-established, technology-driven organization where deep engineering is at the heart of what they build. From a proprietary search engine to advanced cybersecurity solutions, their products are built to handle massive amounts of data and deliver actionable insights in real time.  Their R&D, engineering, and data centers are located in Sweden, headquarters in London, and teams across the US, the company operates on a truly global scale.
Together with our client, we are looking for a motivated C# .NET Developer to join their core engine team, currently consisting of four developers. Here, you will work on the systems that power the platform’s high-volume, near-real-time data processing. You will design and develop scalable backend services and APIs, working closely with data ingestion, search, and indexing technologies. Performance, reliability, scalability, and clean architecture are central to the role, and you will have a real opportunity to influence technical decisions as the platform continues to evolve. You will work in an agile and highly collaborative environment alongside experienced engineers. Most importantly, your work will have a direct impact: the systems you build will help security teams around the world detect and act on critical cyber intelligence.
Work tasks
Design and implement distributed and scalable backend solutions using C# .NET.  
Manage and process large datasets through efficient data pipelines.  
Own the performance and health of our databases and data structures.  
Maintain and evolve the company's proprietary in-house database structures and search engines.  
Build and optimize robust integrations between diverse systems and data sources.  
Leverage modern AI tools in your daily workflow as part of the company-wide AI-first mindset.  
Maintain and optimize existing codebase while actively driving new feature development and modernization initiatives.  
Move between fast-paced integration work and deeper architectural design as the platform evolves.

We are looking for
Platform/support mindset, self-directedness, or production ownership
A couple years experience and advanced knowledge of C# .NET development.
Good knowledge of databases SQL and/or postgres, search engines such as ElasticSearch.
Pragmatic approach to AI with an eagerness to adopt AI-assisted development tools.
Previous experience with one or more of Crawlers, Indexing or Search and Information Retrieval.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

It is meritorious if you have experience in Python.

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Collect, analyze, and visualize data to identify improvement opportunities and enable fact-based decisions.

Support integration between production systems, ERP solutions, and other digital platforms.
Lead or contribute to projects related to MES, WMS, Industry 4.0, and continuous improvement.
Promote Lean ways of working and support process optimization across the organization.
Collaborate with colleagues across functions to implement sustainable and efficient solutions.

Degree in Engineering or a related field, with experience from manufacturing or production environments.
Experience with databases, SQL, ERP systems (such as SAP), and programming.
Knowledge of data analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or similar platforms.

Want to take new light technology from the lab out into the world?
About us
LunaLEC is a Swedish deep tech company that has mastered printed light. Just like text on a newspaper, the light-emitting structure is printed, forming a thin, patterned, flexible device. The light-emitting electrochemical cell (LEC) technology is built on 30 years of research, during which the team behind LunaLEC became the first in the world to fully print a light source. The technology is protected by several patents.
We are now taking the LEC technology from the lab to large-scale roll-to-roll production. This is your opportunity to be part of it from the start and build something significant, as well as working with technology that is not yet on the market. It is a pivotal stage for the company, and you could get the chance to lead it.
About the role
As Process Engineer, you will be the one who takes our process from the lab to industry. You will transfer today's sheet-to-sheet manufacturing to roll-to-roll and build the network of partners who will handle production, from substrates and printing to lamination and quality control. You will work closely with a team with deep expertise in the materials and the technology, while contributing with your experience in production. The role is new, and you will have a strong say in how it takes shape.
Your responsibilities will include:
Leading and owning the scale-up of our production from sheet-to-sheet to roll-to-roll
Implementing and optimising our processes in production environments with partners and in existing facilities
Leading the collaboration with our production partners and taking part in customer and partner demos as well as EU projects
Being responsible for quality, routines and compliance in production
Travelling internationally to implement and follow up production on site

We believe that you…
…hold a Master of Science in Engineering, for example in materials engineering, chemical engineering or physics. You have experience of production, roll-to-roll and process development. Experience of scaling a production process, solution based device fabrication at scale and printed electronics are merits. You communicate fluently in English.
As a person, you are driven, solution-oriented and enjoy taking responsibility. You take ownership of your areas and have a business-oriented mindset. Above all, you want to help build something new and see a unique technology reach the market.
We offer
🚀 The opportunity to become a valued part of a deep tech company on its way out into the world
💡 Plenty of room to make an impact and build a completely new function from the ground up
🌍 An international and dedicated team
✈️ International assignments and close collaboration with customers and partners
About the position
Employment type: Permanent (with an initial 6-month probationary period)
Start: By agreement
Scope: Full-time
Location: Umeå preferred, but remote work with regular visits to Umeå is possible. International travel is part of the role

Read more about us at www.lunalec.com

About us
Areta Group is a growing Nordic corporate services firm supporting international companies, investors and professional clients with accounting, governance and corporate administration across the Nordic region.
We are building a lean, high-quality team and are now looking for a Junior Accountant / Redovisningsekonom to support our growing client portfolio.

jobs.occupation: Industrial Painter / Surface Treatment Technician - Offshore - Norway
jobs.description:
Job description: 
Industrial painting, surface preparation and protective coating work on offshore oil and gas installations in the Norwegian sector of the North Sea. Typical work includes abrasive blasting, water jetting, coating application by airless spray / brush / roller, stripe coating, and application or repair of epoxy intumescent passive fire protection (PFP), including Chartek systems. Work is performed in accordance with project specifications, coating procedures, HSE requirements and client quality standards.

Requirements: 
- Minimum 2 years of relevant, documented experience in industrial painting and surface treatment.
- Hands-on experience with surface preparation, including abrasive blasting and/or high-pressure water jetting, and application of protective coating systems.
- Documented experience with epoxy intumescent passive fire protection (PFP), preferably Chartek or equivalent systems.
- Experience with NORSOK M-501 or equivalent offshore coating requirements is an advantage.
- Trade certificate (fagbrev) in industrial painting/surface treatment is an advantage. Candidates without a trade certificate must meet §13 or equivalent site-test competence requirements, where applicable.
- Minimum B1 level in a Scandinavian language: Norwegian, Swedish or Danish.
- Before offshore mobilisation, candidates must meet the assignment-specific requirements for recognised basic safety/emergency training and a valid offshore medical certificate. Exact certificate requirements will be confirmed during recruitment.
- Strong HSE awareness, quality focus, reliability and ability to work effectively in multicultural project teams.

Type of work contract: 
Permanent employment with JJS ProsjektPartner AS, subject to the applicable probationary period. Offshore assignments are normally organised on a 2 weeks on / 4 weeks off rotation, subject to client and project requirements.

Starting date: 
Expected start: 01.01.2027. Exact mobilisation date to be agreed with the selected candidate.

Working hours: 
Typical 2/4 offshore rotation: 14 days on / 28 days off, normally 12-hour shifts (168 working hours per 6-week rotation cycle), subject to the assignment schedule.

Place of work: 
Offshore installations in the Norwegian sector of the Norwegian Continental Shelf (NCS), depending on assignment.

Salary: 
Salary and applicable supplements in accordance with the relevant Norwegian collective agreement (tariff) and assignment-specific terms.

Other information: 
ProsjektPartner coordinates assignment-related travel and accommodation. Selected candidates will receive guidance on mobilisation, required documentation and client-specific courses. ProsjektPartner can assist with selected training through companies in NSE Gruppen.

About the company: 
JJS ProsjektPartner AS is a Norwegian staffing company specialising in qualified personnel for complex industrial projects, both onshore and offshore. With roots dating back to 2003 and as part of NSE Gruppen, we provide experienced professionals within industrial painting and surface treatment, insulation and cladding, scaffolding, and mechanical trades. Our focus is to supply the right competence at the right time, with high standards for HSE, quality and reliable project execution.

How to apply? 
Send your CV and relevant trade/certificate documentation to marco@propartner.no. Please include a short summary of your surface-treatment, offshore and PFP/Chartek experience. You may also call +47 975 92 360.

Contact: 
Marco Scharin
+47 975 92 360
marco@propartner.no

Marco speaks both Finnish, Norwegian and English, and Finnish-speaking candidates are welcome to contact him directly in Finnish.

Bannerflow is a fast-growing global SaaS company building a Creative Intelligence Platform that enables enterprise brands to predict, create, and optimize advertising across channels. We're on a company-wide AI transformation journey, where AI and agentic workflows are becoming a core part of how we build and sell, with high expectations on adoption across all teams.
We're now strengthening our Sales team for the next phase of the business and are looking for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) who gets energy from who gets energy from starting new conversations with prospects and building pipeline, not just booking meetings.
Where first conversations turn into pipeline
We're seeking an experienced, structured and ambitious SDR to join our growing sales team. You'll play a key role in prospecting and generating qualified leads to support our commercial success. As our SDR, you'll work collaboratively with Account Executives, engage with prospects across international markets, and help drive our growth across both new and existing regions.
You bring a structured and ambitious approach to outbound, a genuine curiosity about enterprise buyers, and a knack for turning a cold conversation into a qualified opportunity. You know how to use data and the right tools to work smarter, not just harder.
What you actually will do

Generate and nurture Sales Qualified Leads, especially in complex and enterprise-level sales cycles.

Educate potential customers about the value of Bannerflow's SaaS platform.

Use tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, Cognism, and our CRM to manage leads and pipeline effectively.

Stay informed about industry trends to bring relevant insights back to the team.

Who you are
We're looking for someone self-driven and AI-native, comfortable using AI to make their prospecting and workflows more impactful and efficient. You bring a start-up/scale-up mentality, and you're happy to pitch in on projects that fall slightly outside a traditional SDR role.
You're a strong fit if:

You have 1.5+ years of SDR experience, ideally in a SaaS environment with enterprise-level complexity.

You thrive in a fast-paced setting, are goal-oriented, and take full ownership of your work.

You communicate fluently in English, and any additional European languages are a major plus.

You're excited by international sales and working with prospects across multiple markets.

You're known for being a proactive team player with a sense of responsibility and strong personal drive.

Why join us?
We live alongside our values of Collaboration, Passion, and Challenge; with many events going on at Bannerflow such as padel tournaments, webinars, Friday beers, and Level-up Hackathons, there's something for everyone.
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.
We offer a hybrid workplace and a competitive compensation package including pension according to ITP1, health allowance, parental leave top-up, and health care insurance.
Sound like you? We'd love to hear how you'd bring energy, structure, and curiosity to our team.  Apply now and become part of our journey!

At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a driven Customer Success Specialist to support our Benelux operations.
About the Role
In this hybrid role, you will bridge relationship management with active credit risk assessment. You will manage incoming SMB loan applications, conduct financial health checks, and guide Dutch-speaking business owners through their lending journey, ensuring both strong customer satisfaction and healthy portfolio quality.
Key Responsibilities
Evaluate and process standard-to-mid complexity SMB loan applications using our risk frameworks and credit data.

Act as the main consultative contact for business applicants in Dutch, guiding them through underwriting and closing deals.

Analyze financial statements, cash flow patterns, and credit reports to verify deal quality and risk profiles.

Collaborate with senior underwriters on complex, high-ticket cases that require customized financing structures.

Act as a voice of the customer, sharing insights to continuously improve our product and localized operational processes.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a commercially driven, analytical team player who understands business finance and loves solving problems for entrepreneurs. You possess strong interpersonal skills, carry an eye for numerical detail, and are eager to take clear ownership of SMB credit applications.
Qualifications
A few years experience in Customer Success, B2B account management, strategic lending, or credit processing within Banking, Fintech, or Financial Services.

Hands-on familiarity with evaluating financial statements, corporate documents, and credit scoring models.

Native or professional fluency in Dutch, combined with strong professional English.

A structured approach, good business acumen, and a keen interest in SMB financing models.

Strong communication and negotiation skills with a drive to help small businesses succeed.

Detail-oriented, comfortable working with data, and skilled at prioritizing tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Why Qred?
This role offers a clear path to fast-track your career in commercial lending and fintech. Qred operates with a non-bureaucratic structure, short decision paths, and a high-performing culture where initiative is rewarded. You will take true ownership of your portfolio while deepening your credit and financial expertise alongside top industry talent.
One Last Thing
This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach with the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis, and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. 
 
 
#LI-Onsite

Job Scope
High level purpose of function.
Supports the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the company's health and safety management system.
Ensures compliance with applicable work environment legislation, regulations, and company requirements. Identifies, assesses, and supports the control of occupational risks through risk assessments, exposure monitoring, inspections, and incident investigations.
Supports managers and operational teams in the daily work environment and safety activities, including risk assessments, investigations, and follow-up of incidents, near misses, and risk observations.
Promotes a proactive safety culture and contributes to continuous improvement of health and safety performance.
Key Responsibilities

Collaborate closely with managers and stakeholders across the organization to lead, coordinate, and advance systematic health and safety management and the development of a strong safety culture.
Participates in the work of building up a Health & Safety management system in accordance with the requirements of ISO 45001 and Lyten's internal standards.
Carry out training in health and safety.
Compile and follow up KPI´s and report to management and other relevant parties.
Support the organization in connection with risk assessments and other risk reviews.
If necessary, support with investigations of incidents and accidents, with the aim of finding root causes and proposing measures to prevent it from happening again.
Carry out investigations regarding physical work environment aspects such as exposure to chemical substances, noise, and ergonomic factors.
Support the organization with expertise within health and safety.
Inform, train, and coach leaders and employees in health and safety. 
Monitor and interpret changes in regulations.
Manage or perform occupational exposure measurement.
Manage and be superuser for existing systems regarding health and safety (TIA).
Provide technical solutions for change management and new projects within health and safety.
Lead or participate in health and safety related committees.
Contacts with authorities.

Accountability/Authorization

Budget responsibility: No
Direct reports: No
Manager work environment responsibility: No
All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace.

Requirements
Educational background and previous experience required for the role.
Degree in engineering, occupational health and safety, work environment engineering, or another relevant discipline, or equivalent qualifications demonstrated through education and professional experience.
5+ years of work experience as a health and safety engineer, specialist or coordinator. 
Strong knowledge and experience with Swedish health and safety legislation, rules, regulations, and reporting processes. 
Good knowledge of data analysis and risk assessment methods.
Knowledge of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.
Experience in the battery manufacturing industry is a plus. 
Expertise in specific areas within health and safety, for example ergonomics, ATEX, or chemicals is a plus.

Specific skills
Excellent English written and oral skills, Swedish is a plus.
Highly organized and result driven.
Ability to work well with others in a team environment, as well as independently.
Has a can-do attitude and an entrepreneurial spirit.
Qualities that we cherish are flexibility, sense of quality, friendliness, motivation to take on new challenges

About us
Hacksaw Studios is a Stockholm-based game studio focused on creating innovative, high-quality gaming experiences. With a focus on performance and precision, we bring ideas to life through technical expertise and creative collaboration. We have wide distribution, and our games are played by millions of people every month by players all over the world.
We are now looking for a Project Manager to join our team. The team is responsible for developing Hacksaw Studios’ own games, bringing together expertise from different functions.
The Role
In this role, you will plan, coordinate, and support game projects from concept through to release. You will act as a central point of coordination between departments, helping teams stay aligned and ensuring that projects meet their timelines, quality standards, and creative goals.
Your key responsibilities include:
Taking ownership of assigned game projects, from initial planning through execution and delivery.
Creating and maintaining project plans, schedules, milestones, and priorities in our project management system.
Coordinating across functions to ensure an efficient workflow and alignment on project scope, goals, responsibilities, and deadlines.
Monitoring progress, quality, risks, and potential blockers, and supporting the teams in resolving issues proactively.
Facilitating project kick-offs, milestone check-ins, reviews, and other relevant meetings.
Keeping the Team Lead and relevant stakeholders informed about project progress, changes, risks, and key decisions.
Participating in review and feedback cycles to ensure consistency and high-quality deliverables.
Identifying improvements to workflows and tools that strengthen quality, efficiency, and collaboration.
Staying up to date with industry trends, game development practices, and player preferences.

What We’re Looking For
Experience in project management or production, ideally involving several projects or workstreams simultaneously.
A structured, organized, and proactive approach to your work.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
The ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and create clarity around responsibilities, priorities, and deadlines.
A collaborative mindset and the confidence to take ownership of assigned project areas.
The ability to identify risks and proactively seek guidance or clarification when needed.
Openness to feedback and a willingness to continuously develop your ways of working.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Swedish and English.

Nice to Have
Experience in the gaming or iGaming industry.
Experience coordinating creative and technical teams.
Familiarity with game development processes and project management tools.
Experience in or a strong interest in technology. 
A personal interest in games and game development.

What We Offer
A modern office in central Stockholm.
The opportunity to work with experienced and passionate colleagues in the gaming industry.
The chance to help create games played by a global audience.
Real influence, ownership, and opportunities for personal and professional growth.
Wellbeing benefits, including a wellness allowance and regular in-office massages.

Practical Details
This is an on-site position in Stockholm.
Unfortunately, we cannot assist with relocation or visa sponsorship.
